title: Orthodontists
description: Examine, diagnose, and treat dental malocclusions and oral cavity anomalies. Design and fabricate appliances to realign teeth and jaws to produce and maintain normal function and to improve appearance.

tasks.text: Diagnose teeth and jaw or other dental-facial abnormalities.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Dental diagnosis needs imaging and clinical exam

tasks.text: Examine patients to assess abnormalities of jaw development, tooth position, and other dental-facial structures.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Oral examination requires direct hands-on inspection

dwas.name: Examine mouth, teeth, gums, or related facial structures.

tasks.text: Study diagnostic records, such as medical or dental histories, plaster models of the teeth, photos of a patient's face and teeth, and X-rays, to develop patient treatment plans.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment goals need clinical accountability and context

dwas.name: Analyze patient data to determine patient needs or treatment goals.

tasks.text: Fit dental appliances in patients' mouths to alter the position and relationship of teeth and jaws or to realign teeth.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fine manual adjustment of dental appliances in mouth

dwas.name: Adjust dental devices or appliances to ensure fit.

tasks.text: Adjust dental appliances to produce and maintain normal function.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fine manual adjustment of dental appliances in mouth

dwas.name: Adjust dental devices or appliances to ensure fit.

tasks.text: Provide patients with proposed treatment plans and cost estimates.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Medical communication needs empathy and clinical accountability

dwas.name: Communicate detailed medical information to patients or family members.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

tasks.text: Advise patients to comply with treatment plans.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Treatment-effect advice needs clinical tailoring

dwas.name: Confer with clients to discuss treatment plans or progress.
dwas.gwa_name: Interpreting the Meaning of Information for Others

dwas.name: Advise patients on effects of health conditions or treatments.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Patient history requires live elicitation and judgment

tasks.text: Instruct dental officers and technical assistants in orthodontic procedures and techniques.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Provider training is clinical, hands-on, accountable

tasks.text: Coordinate orthodontic services with other dental and medical services.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Treatment planning collaboration is accountable clinical work

dwas.name: Collaborate with healthcare professionals to plan or provide treatment.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Design and fabricate appliances, such as space maintainers, retainers, and labial and lingual arch wires.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI assists concepts; device design requires regulatory and physical testing
